mapper.select: SELECT sa.id as application_id, sa.schedule_id, j.id as job_id, j.title as job_title, sa.worker_id, w.name as worker_name, w.phone as worker_phone, wp.gender AS worker_gender, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, sa.status, sa.applied_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, wp.birthday, CURDATE()) AS worker_age FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON sa.worker_id = w.id LEFT JOIN worker_profiles wp ON sa.worker_id = wp.worker_id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC
